fault_policy: Low SOC pauses EV then irrigation/AWG and flexible loads; keep B1/B2/B3 within measured power limits.
Separate breakers improve branch isolation but do not remove the shared inverter/BMS supply failure.
Pump dry-run and leak detection stop affected water branch; no automatic restarting against a known leak.
UV fault/quality alarm closes the relevant treated-water supply including food garden; use sealed drinking backup.
